title: The Gaza Famine Truthers
author: Lee Fang
content:
Yesterday The Free Press [published](https://www.thefp.com/p/journalists-
against-journalism-media-news-editorial) an editorial defending a recent
report of theirs that sought to question whether there's really mass
starvation in the Gaza Strip. We dedicated this whole episode to discussing
the controversy and the genocide surrounding it.

[ Read more ](https://www.leefang.com/p/the-gaza-famine-truthers)
